text:
Emma: quick RFC follow-up — we need a concrete plan for retry budgets + backpressure on the telemetry ingest path. saw some production retries spike yesterday and it bubbled into storage pressure. can we sync on guardrails?
Raj: +1. can you paste the spike timeline? was it a burst from one service or broad?
Emma: looks like a 10x burst from mobile SDK over ~3m. traces show repeated 429s then exponential retry.
Maya: if clients are doing exponential retries we should cap client retry budget server-side. otherwise downstream queues fill.
Liam: agree. we also need a server-side token-bucket limiter that's observable per-tenant + a global circuit.
Emma: proposal: keep a soft retry_budget per-tenant and a hard global budget. once soft exhausted return 429 w/ Retry-After header. if global exhausted return 503.
Raj: how about allowing short backpressure window instead of immediate 429s? like return 429 but with small random jitter in Retry-After so clients stagger.
Maya: jitter is good. also add a flag to mark requests as "non-critical" (ingest hint) so we can drop lower priority metrics/traces when pressured.
Liam: need to define the budgets — defaults and autoscale. Suggest default tenant_budget = 200 req/s, burst 2x, global_budget = 50k req/s, global_burst = 1.5x.
Emma: can you throw that in a quick config snippet?
Liam: sure:
```
retry_policy:
  tenant_default:
    rate: 200/s
    burst: 400
  global:
    rate: 50000/s
    burst: 75000
  jitter_on_busy: true
  soft_behavior: 429
  hard_behavior: 503
```
Maya: also add a short token-lease window for the token bucket to avoid thundering herd when tokens refill. e.g., lease_ttl = 100ms.
Raj: how do we expose this in telemetry? need metrics: tenant_retry_budget_used, tenant_retries_dropped, global_rejects, avg_retry_after_ms.
Emma: yes. also add tracing tags on rejected spans: ingest.retry_reason=(soft|hard), ingest.tenant_budget_used=%.
ingest-bot: ALERT: config-change applied to staging: retry_policy.jitter_on_busy=true, lease_ttl=100ms
Maya: can we implement a gradual rollout? start with conservative tenant_default 50/s in staging and run load tests.
Liam: plan: rollout stages: staging -> 10% prod -> 50% prod -> global. monitor global_rejects and latency p50/p95.
Raj: one more edge-case: what if a tenant legitimately needs high throughput (batch uploads)? we should allow per-tenant overrides via opt-in reserved capacity (Dedicated customers).
Emma: agreed — reserved_capacity bypasses soft budget and routes to dedicated pool; still subject to global safety.
Maya: ops runbook note: when global_rejects spike, check mobile SDK version and recent client rollouts first. 99% cases are SDK bug.
Liam: I'll open a tiny RFC PR with config defaults + metrics + rollout plan. tagging you all: @Emma @Raj @Maya
Emma: perfect, thanks. short follow-up in PR for wording on Retry-After semantics. :thumbsup:
